author: Ben Janca
description:
Rockstar's next GTA game for the PS5 and Xbox is only a few months away, and the team is dramatically shaking up the formula.

This week we're talking about carjacking and how it changes nearly every aspect of Grand Theft Auto as we know it.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA6) – We NEED To Talk About Carjacking

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Carjacking in Grand Theft Auto games has been, as the title denotes, a staple of the series. Up until now, it's largely been the same. While there have been more details and animations added over the years, the premise has remained that you'll walk up to a car, press Y or Triangle, throw the driver out, get in and drive away. If the car was parked, you'd execute the same button press to smash the window and steal it. With GTA 6, carjacking is getting a complete overhaul. Here, we've got all of the information we know so far on how to steal cars in GTA 6.

There are two ways to steal a car: taking one that's stationary, or taking one that someone's driving around in. However, there are more details that make GTA 6 feel more like true simulation gameplay now.
title: GTA 6 Is Completely Changing How You Steal Cars

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you eager to read more guides for The Blood of Dawnwalker? This RPG offers an expansive open world and thrilling action. As Coen, you must race against time to save your loved ones. With the brutality of life as a mortal and the viciousness of a vampire, it’s up to you to bring down the hated overlords that have plundered your home region of Vale Sangora.

In This Article
  • Basics and starter guides
title: The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Guides Hub

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Horror fans are confused. Every time a licensed multiplayer horror game gets brought up, two things tend to happen: commenters wonder if it can dethrone Dead by Daylight, and they speculate that the game will shut down quickly. It's happening again today, as I've recently published my Halloween review. Comments on YouTube and in Discord servers are already repeating the sentiments I've seen for many years now.

"Probably be dead in six months to a year because no one can live aside DBD."

"It will be dead within a month like the rest."

"The real question is, will it go the way of Evil Dead, Friday the 13th, and Texas Chain Saw, and not touch Dead by Daylight?"

I view this response as a kind of mass hallucination. This obsession over a game
title: I’m Begging You To Stop Obsessing Over Player Numbers And Just Enjoy Games

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you looking for Lacra in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This fiendish vrakhiri--a potentially romanceable character at that--has been stalking her prey all over Vale Sangora. If you know the right people to ask, you might just learn of her whereabouts.

A Friend Like This - Where to find Lacra in Svartrau City

The quest where you find Lacra in The Blood of Dawnwalker is called A Friend Like This. It’s not available right from the get-go. Instead, you have to put in a bit of effort by heading to Svartrau City.

There, you’ll meet a benign vrakhiri named Vicho, who wants your help in solving a murder. You can learn about the details in our
title: Where To Find Lacra In The Blood Of Dawnwalker

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you looking for the hidden Uriash Village in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This settlement is in a far-flung region that most humans can’t even reach. In fact, it will remain accessible to Coen unless you’re able to tackle some pre-requisite tasks.

Song of the Mountain - The Hidden Uriash Village

The hidden Uriash Village in The Blood of Dawnwalker, which is in the western corner of the map, can’t be visited under normal circumstances. If you attempt to climb up the mountainous area west of Rockfalls, a prompt will tell you that you’re not allowed to go any further, causing you to respawn some distance away.

To gain access to it, you must first meet a vampiress named Lacra. You can learn about all the info in
title: Where To Find The Hidden Uriash Village In The Blood Of Dawnwalker

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Do you want to help Ocha in The Blood of Dawnwalker? The daughter of the uriash matriarch is somewhere in the capital, and she seems to have gotten into a bit of trouble. Our guide, which tackles A Mother’s Plea and The Heart Wants What It Wants, has all the info you need. We discuss everything from Ocha’s location and the memento that you need for a hex, right down to the responses that you need to pick to make Osha go back home or stay in the city.

In This Article
title: How To Help Ocha In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – The Heart Wants What It Wants Guide

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Do you want to increase your character’s maximum health in The Blood of Dawnwalker? Survival is of the utmost importance, especially since you’ll be fighting against battalions of soldiers, hordes of undead, and cadres of vampiric hostiles. Thankfully, there’s a legendary herb that grants a one-time boon.

In This Article
  • The Hedgehog Herb and Razkovniche Plant guide
title: There’s A Legendary Herb In The Blood Of Dawnwalker That Permanently Increases Your Health

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you looking for ways to save Mert in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This miller happens to be a cousin of one of Coen’s close friends. He might even be connected to a rebel group that’s planning to overthrow the vrakhiri overlords. Unfortunately, he’s rotting in a prison, but you have a chance to free him.

In This Article
  • The Firebrand quest guide - How to save Mert with the
title: How To Save Mert In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – The Firebrand Guide

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you thinking of whether you should abandon or spare Isbrand in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This ancient vampire lord has been around for centuries, though he’s been left in a weakened state. Maybe he can aid you in the battles ahead? Oh, and before we continue, please know that this guide contains spoilers.

In This Article
  • Our Rotten Roots quest guide - Should
title: Should You Spare Isbrand In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Our Rotten Roots Guide

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you hoping to help Father Florin in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This wily priest hasn’t been around since the prologue. If you do manage to find him, then he has a proposal that might pique your interest. Of course, he also has his ulterior motives. Our guide has all the details that you need as we discuss several quests, including In the Name of the Father, Hero’s End, and Champion of Old. By the time you’re done with these activities, you should have at least four legendary items.

In This Article
title: How To Help Father Florin In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Hero’s End Guide

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you searching for all the Sword Shards in The Blood of Dawnwalker? These items are necessary if you want to complete the Forge It Anew quest. With these, you’ll be able to create one of the best weapons in the entire game.

In This Article
  • Forge It Anew - All Sword Shards in Vale Sangora
title: All Sword Shard Locations In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Forge It Anew Guide

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you trying to repair St. Mihai’s Sword in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This armament was once wielded by a renowned warrior, who was eventually canonized by the church. Now, it lays forgotten deep underground. If you’re up to the task, then you might claim it as your own. Oh, and before we continue, please be reminded that this article contains minor spoilers.

In This Article
title: How To Repair St. Mihai’s Sword In The Blood Of Dawnwalker

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you excited to look for all the legendary gear in The Blood of Dawnwalker? There are plenty of powerful items scattered all across Vale Sangora. If you’re bold, you might have a chance at finding most of them. Our guide has all the details that you need to help you in this endeavor, and we’ve also included links to related guides. As an aside, given that we’re going to discuss some top-tier rewards, this article is going to contain lots of spoilers.

In This Article
title: Best Gear In Blood Of Dawnwalker – All Legendary Weapons And Armor

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Writer-director Neil Druckmann dropped out of HBO's The Last of Us TV show to focus on Naughty Dog's gaming output, including Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet. In a new interview, he said Season 3--which, again, he had no direct involvement in, will "wrap up" the series. He also revealed that, unlike Seasons 1 and 2, Naughty Dog "did not have a creative role in the direction" of Season 3.

Druckmann said this to The Washington Post, confirming, "I wasn't involved in shaping this season's creative direction," nor was Naughty Dog involved. "So I can't personally speak to how production is progressing," he said.
title: The Last of Us Season 3 Did Not Include Naughty Dog’s Involvement For Creative Choices

author: Chris Pereira
description:
With BlizzCon just a week away, there's new reason to believe that some kind of StarCraft news is on the way. Various visual elements on the official StarCraft website are now glitching out in a way that looks much more "hey fans, get excited" than "alert the engineering team that we've got a problem."

The glitches were flagged on Bluesky by John Carson, and they specifically appear on the section of Blizzard's website advertising 2017's StarCraft Remastered, rather than StarCraft II. The glitches see certain images and text become briefly distorted, though to my eye, there is nothing specific to glean from them.
title: Something Is Brewing With StarCraft

author: Jessica Cogswell
description:
Earlier this summer, Wizards of the Coast announced a major shakeup coming to Dungeons & Dragons: the addition of Universes Beyond. Essentially, this means that Wizards now has a formal process for adding pre-existing properties to D&D, two of which have already been announced: World of Warcraft and Star Wars.

For those who partake in Wizard of the Coast's other wildly popular, fantasy-based property that you play on a table, Magic: The Gathering, this might sound extremely familiar--and you might not be too happy about it. Universes Beyond as a concept was introduced to Magic: The Gathering in 2021, shortly after the company released a The Walking Dead crossover that was then retroactively made part of the initiative. Since then, dozens of IP have made the jump from their respective worlds to t
title: Universes Beyond Coming To Dungeons & Dragons Is Fine, Actually

author: Miri Teixeira
description: Does being the leader of a cult automatically make you a bad guy? Doomsday cult sim Join Us might make that a more nuanced question than it initially appears. We got some hands-on cult-building time at Gamescom this year and saw a glimpse of how varied an experience different players could cultivate. You probably are a villain, but the flavor of your sin is yours to choose, and is it really all that terrible if you're merely herding your flock into salvation?
title: “Cult” Isn’t A Four-Letter Word In Join Us

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
The D&D Icons initiative, led by actor and longtime D&D fanatic Joe Manganiello, brings today's Dungeons & Dragons game together with famous series creators of the past, like author R.A. Salvatore's The Legend of Drizzt. But things aren't going to be strictly limited to classic fantasy settings, Manganiello has teased.

Speaking to GameSpot's Jessica Cogswell at Gen Con 2026, Manganiello stressed that modern-day settings could be part of the Icons program, too.

"There [are] also lots of other things that I want for Icons in the future," he said. "I think that there's a great present-day game that pushes genetics and military. We're moving at such a rapid pace, but I think there could be a game that takes place in our modern world. There are also some
title: Dungeons And Dragons Icons Could Take The TTRPG To A Modern-Day Setting

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Gundam Rogue Orbit is a break from tradition for Bandai Namco, as new entries in the franchise typically debut as an anime series first, then as a line of collectible model kits. But this Gundam is arriving first as a video game--one that was shown in more detail today during the September PlayStation State of Play broadcast. If you're a Gundam fan, fret not, because at least one part of the traditional Gundam experience is being kept intact if you buy the $160 Rogue Orbit collector's edition.
title: The New Gundam Game Has A Collector’s Edition Just For Gunpla Sickos Like Me

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft has made a big announcement about one of the big perks of Xbox Game Pass, cloud streaming, and the news is not great.

Starting in November, Microsoft will put limits on how many hours per month people can use the service, and then allow people to pay more to unlock more time. Below is a breakdown of how many hours you'll get included with the tier of Game Pass you're subscribed to:

  • Game Pass Ultimate: 15 hours
  • Game Pass Premium: 10 hours
  • Game Pass Essential: 5 hours

Microsoft said it understands this is a "meaningful change," especially for those who use the cloud regularly for gaming. However, the company said it estimates that these changes will impact about 4% of Game Pass subscribers, though the company did not share any specifics on how it arrived at
title: Game Pass Is Getting Worse, And More Expensive

author: Andrew King
description:
The original Metroid and Castlevania both turn 40 years old this fall. As the two series most responsible for creating the “metroidvania,” we’re taking this occasion to take a comprehensive view of the popular genre. This is Metroidvania Week.

Metroidvanias have been around for decades, with numerous high points over those years. Super Metroid–which set the template for the beloved (and much-iterated-upon) formula–hit the SNES in 1994. Castlevania: Symphony of the Night–which established a bold, non-linear direction for the series and helped pioneer the genre–followed in 1997. Metroid Prime–which proved this kind of game could work in 3D–touched down on the GameCube in 2002. And Hollow Knight: Silksong–which put metroidvanias at the center of gaming culture for one of the only times in their history–hit in late 2025. </
title: The Metroidvania Is Decades Old, But One Year In Particular Is The Undisputed King

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Dungeons & Dragons is no stranger to crossovers with other IP, and a collaboration with Blizzard's World of Warcraft also already on the way. However, that may not be the only Blizzard crossover we get in D&D, as both Wizards of the Coast and Blizzard teased recently.

Speaking to GameSpot's Jessica Cogswell during Gen Con 2026, head of Dungeons & Dragons Dan Ayoub made it clear that he would love a StarCraft crossover.

"I will say this, since I am sitting here with [World of Warcraft VP] Holly Longdale, who is super persuasive and has cool stuff: I think StarCraft would be badass," Ayoub said. "As I said earlier today, I quite literally almost flunked out of university because of StarCraft. That one gives me the feels."
title: A Long-Dormant Blizzard Franchise Could Be Coming To Dungeons And Dragons

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Dungeons & Dragons fans will soon be exploring the dangerous lands of Azeroth, as World of Warcraft is coming to the tabletop game. Wizards of the Coast (WotC) and Blizzard have gone all-out with this crossover, as not only does it feature multiple World of Warcraft classes and six additional subclasses, but also various specializations, spells, items, and enemies. That sounds like a dream pairing between two titans of the fantasy genre, but could we see Dungeons & Dragons make an appearance in World of Warcraft's digital realms?

WotC isn't saying anything official right now, but in an interview at Gen Con with GameSpot's Jessica Cogswell, Head of Dungeons & Dragons Dan Ayoub and VP of World of Warcraft for Blizzard Holly Longdale were c
title: D&D’s World Of Warcraft Crossover May Not Be A One-Way Street

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Universes Beyond has been a major hit for Wizards of the Coast (WotC), as drawing outside intellectual properties like Final Fantasy into Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons has brought new audiences to those tabletop experiences. But what about the core games that serve as a foundation for Universes Beyond? There is some concern amongst the fandom that Universes Beyond could delay or replace original core D&D rulebooks and campaigns, but WotC says that the classic side of the franchise is still its top priority.

"A lot of the goal for it on our side was those new audiences," head of Dungeons & Dragons Dan Ayoub said to GameSpot's Jessica Cogswell at Gen Con. "There is certainly the fandom of, 'Oh cool, I want to play in Azeroth.' There is absolutely that layer. But a lot of things we want to do—and one thing that I am really passionate about—is bringing new players in. Role-playing games have been
title: D&D Says Universes Beyond Is Designed To Bring In New Players, Not Push Out Existing Fans

author: Jade King
description:
Revealed during today’s State of Play presentation, Pearl Abyss has confirmed that Crimson Desert’s first major expansion will be launching in October. It not only adds a new region and plenty of new narrative surprises, but also gameplay features that pull from the most unlikely of places. If the reveal trailer is any indication, Crimson Desert could soon be a life sim that gives The Sims a run for its money. 

In Chartering the Unknown, players can expect underwater combat in which you pilot submarines, ride sharks, and use a jetpack to propel yourself through the beautiful ocean blue. In classic Crimson Desert fashion, it looks absolutely ridiculous, with no rhyme or reason to its mechanical intentions or oddball ar
title: Crimson Desert Channels The Sims With Its Chartering The Unknown Expansion

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The Crunchyroll Game Vault is expanding, as the anime brand has announced several new additions to its collection of mobile games. Available as a membership perk for Mega and Ultimate Fan subscribers, the Game Vault will now offer more than 100 games free of ads and in-app purchases, with new arrivals like Baki Hanma: Blood Arena and ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs being added to the service.

For fans of cozy experiences, ReStory is a delightful game where you run an electronics workshop and spend the day restoring old tech to working order while listening to some chill lofi beats. Designed to be satisfying and relaxing, it's a nostalgic look back at retro gaming hardware, cellphones, and other essential gadgets. Other upcoming games being added to Crunchyroll's vault include the stylish psychological-horror adventure Little G
title: One Of The Coziest Games Of The Year Is Helping Crunchyroll Game Vault Grow Even Bigger

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
CD Projekt joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski has commented on how the studio thinks about artificial intelligence when it comes to developing games.

Speaking during CD Projekt's latest earnings briefing, the executive said AI is "definitely becoming a thing in games development." However, he stressed that the Polish developer is still "predominantly using people" to make games.

"AI, if anything, is a tool like many others that's helping in places that can maybe become more helpful in the future but we're not planning to rely on AI making complete games," he said,
title: The Witcher 4 Will Be Made “Predominantly Using People” And Not AI

author: Chris Compendio
description:
After its liberation from Microsoft's ownership, the newly independent Double Fine Productions has been quite busy. At the September 2026 State of Play, PlayStation revealed that Double Fine's surreal adventure Keeper is shadow-dropping on PS5, and the studio added that the acclaimed game is getting some intriguing updates.

Along with the surprise PS5 release, Keeper is also getting a "Psychedelic Mode," which is probably exactly what it sounds like. Considering how much bizarre imagery is already in the game, an even more "wild new way" to play the game should be a treat. And Double Fine wants to sweeten the deal with a price cut, which the studio implemented with
title: Double Fine Flexes Its Independence With Price Cuts And A New PS5 Release

author: Steve Watts
description:
We've come to expect a certain caliber of game from Sony State of Play: high production value, high artistic value. The trailers ran the gamut from Wolverine to a major expansion for Ghost of Yotei to an extended look at Final Fantasy 7 Resonance. All of these games look serious and expensive and artistic. They're the types of games for us Serious Gamers (™) who play Serious Games (™). Even the surprise appearance of Double Fine's Keeper is a showcase of a beautiful and artistically ambitious game. That may be why seeing Maneater 2, an action-RPG where you play as an angry and vengeful shark, felt so refreshing. 

The first Maneater was a silly concept that managed to squeeze out more depth than I expected. As a baby shark, you see your mother brutally killed by a reality-TV shark hunter named Scaly Pete, so you devote your whole shark life to growing bigger and stronger. It's an old-scho
title: Maneater 2 Looks Like A Dang Hoot (FYI, The Shark Can Wallrun Now)

author: Tomas Franzese
description:
The most exciting part of a video game showcase is when developers shadow-drop something immediately after announcing it. Today's State of Play had a few such announcements. Demos for a new Final Fantasy game and anime-inspired action titles, as well as a port of a Double Fine game that was previously Xbox exclusive, are out now.

Final Fantasy Resonance Demo
title: Everything From The State Of Play That You Can Try Right Now

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Following Nintendo, both Sony and Microsoft have now argued in court that they are not obligated to provide refunds to consumers who paid more for a price-hiked PlayStation or Xbox console related to US President Donald Trump's controversial tariff plan. The tariffs were deemed illegal, prompting companies to seek refunds. The companie
title: Sony And Microsoft: We’re Keeping Tariff Refunds For Ourselves And You’ll Get Nothing

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
With the release date of Final Fantasy VII Revelation confirmed as April 8 during today's PlayStation State of Play, it seems Steam is jumping the gun on what comes after, as two downloadable story expansions have appeared on the digital storefront.

Each expansion features specific characters, with the first called "Sephiroth" and the second called "Vincent and the Turks." Both are listed as release "between Winter 2027 and April 2028. No other information is included with the listings.
title: FFVII Revelation DLC Feature Sephiroth And Vincent, Extending The Story Into 2028

author: Max Blumenthal
description: Final Fantasy Resonance is a return to classic series conventions while also evolving Square Enix's HD-2D style.
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Hands-On Preview

author: Alan Wen
description:
Given its rich legacy spanning almost four decades, it's something of a surprise that Square Enix has taken its time to give Final Fantasy an outing in HD-2D, the retro-modern aesthetic that clearly harks back to the pinnacle of pixel art from RPG classics of the 16-bit era, including Final Fantasy VI. But rather than introduce this visual style to the franchise with a brand-new title, Square Enix is using the HD-2D treatment to reimagine and preserve a now-defunct mobile game. Final Fantasy Resonance is a reimagining of Final Fantasy Brave Exvius that's similar in scope to Octopath Traveler 0, an enhanced console adaptation for Octopath Traveler: Champions of the Continent.

Although Final Fantasy Resonance is a retelling of Brave Exvius's first season, casting you in the role of Rain along with party members Lasswell, Fina, and Lid, the mobile title
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Is A Return To Classic Series Conventions While Also Evolving Square Enix’s HD-2D Style

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Epic Games has announced that it's going to make it easier than ever to hang out and talk with friends across different platforms by launching Epic Parties. This voice chat service will work across Fortnite (on all supported platforms), the Epic Games Store launcher (PC, iOS, and Android), and the Epic Games app (iOS and Android).

For example, you can start a voice party from your phone or PC launcher, ring up a friend who is busy playing Fortnite on their PlayStation, and even transfer that call from your phone to your PC when you get back to your desk. This means that you can sit in on a voice call through the Epic PC Launcher while playing completely different games from your Epic library. Other benefits include a seamless approach to grouping friends together, as Epic says that if you're in a voice party with friends and everyone decides to open Fortnite, then the game will automatically drop you all into the
title: Epic Games’ New Voice Chat Lets You Keep Talking To Friends While Playing Different Games

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
During today's State of Play broadcast, Sony announced that two limited-edition Grand Theft Auto 6-themed DualSense controllers will be released.

They'll come in black or white and feature distinctive Leonida-themed graphics and coloring. Both have pastel pink icons on the buttons, with a blue-purple shift that sparkles along the bottom of the controller.
title: GTA 6 Limited-Edition DualSense Controllers Are On The Way, And They Look Fantastic

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar Games has confirmed new details about how fishing and hunting work in GTA 6, and it's probably not what you would expect.

Speaking to YouTuber TGG, Rockstar North's Rob Nelson confirmed that fishing in GTA 6 is limited to catch and release--players cannot keep any fish. Why? "It didn't fit this game," Nelson said, adding that fishing in GTA 6 is mainly for fun. Players can also complete fishing-related challenges and amass collectibles.
title: GTA 6 Fishing And Hunting Doesn’t Work Like You Think It Does

author: Chris Pereira
description:
Final Fantasy VII Revelation finally has a release date: April 8, 2027. Sony confirmed the new today as part of its State of Play.

This story is developing...
title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Arrives In April

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
As part of the September 3 State of Play event, Sony announced more games for the PlayStation Plus catalog.

Devolver's customizable looter-shooter Mycopunk is launching directly into the PlayStation Plus Premium and Extra tiers in October 2026, the company said.

Additionally, more PlayStation "classics" are coming over the next few months for Premium subscribers, including Mega Man X Command Mission, Dino
title: More PlayStation Plus Games Revealed, Including A Day-One Release

author: Steve Watts
description:
A Lego set paying homage to the classic original PlayStation console was officially announced at the Sony State of Play, confirming rumors from earlier this year. The brief look at the upcoming set showed off the build, including clicky buttons and some tiny vignettes to classic PlayStation games.

A post on the PlayStation Blog details the set. The 1,911-piece set is built to be almost a 1:1 scale to the original PlayStation. It includes a model PlayStation console and controller, and will cost $180 when it releases on October 4.
title: Lego PlayStation Officially Announced

author: Tomas Franzese
description:
During today's State of Play, 4A Games revealed new PS5 Pro footage of Metro 2039 and finally confirmed the game's release date.

Narrowing down from a previously known February 2027 release window, it's now confirmed that the game will be out on February 4 of next year. That means it's currently the first high-profile AAA game launch in a month that will be full of them. In
title: Metro 2039 Kicks Off A Busy February Full Of Video Game Launches

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
Today, during the PlayStation State of Play livestream, Sucker Punch offered a look at Ghost of Yotei's upcoming roguelike mode, Most Wanted. The mode will feature four playable characters, and Yotei's Atsu, Oyuki, and Nagato will be joined by a familar face from the past: The Ghost of Tsushima, Jin Sakai, will officially return.

Most Wanted, which the trailer calls a "combat survival mode," lets players choose one of the four samurai, each with their own weapons and abilities, to take them on a hunt for one of the Yotei Six. Each of the Six, if defeated, will offer a reward of coins that can then be spent to upgrade the samurai for future runs.
title: Jin Sakai Returns In Upcoming Ghost Of Yotei Roguelike DLC

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
During the September 3 State of Play, Sony debuted a new clip from the upcoming Resident Evil movie, and it was both dark and hilarious. That should be no surprise, as comedy and horror are naturally intertwined, and the movie is written and directed by sketch comedy veteran Zach Cregger.

In the clip, we see Austin Abrams' character, the medical courier Bryan, running down a street in Raccoon City as zombies throw themselves off rooftops trying to catch him. They explode on impact, with blood flying everywhere.

Bryan screams as he runs down the street amidst the carnage, uttering some hilarious n
title: Resident Evil Trailer Shows The Sequence Where Its Star Almost Died For Real

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
If you're anything like me, seeing the announcement of another anime-style open-world game back in 2023 raised an eyebrow. There are so many games in a similar vein that I glance at, think look cool, and then don't find quite appealing enough to actually get me to sink time into them. Ananta had me looking twice, though. Ananta features multiple vehicles, engaging storyline missions, a roster of appealing characters, and a vast open world, meaning it's regularly referred to as "anime GTA."

While my hands-on time with Naked Rain's free-to-play urban RPG at Gamescom 2026 was enjoyable, I'm still left a little confused about how the final game will look when it's released in 2027. To begin with, the story mission I played and the open world I engaged with were marked as two completely separate modes in the menu, although Rain, the game
title: Anime GTA-Style Game Ananta’s Massive Open World Could Be Its Greatest Strength Or Its Biggest Problem

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Guild Wars 3 made its debut earlier this year at Summer Game Fest, but at the time it didn't give eager MMORPG fans much to go on aside from a name and a brief look at its aesthetic. Still, it was hard not to get excited about a new entry in an MMO franchise known for making bold moves, especially at a time when big swings in the genre are few and far between.

After seeing an early-alpha, hands-off demo of Guild Wars 3 that highlighted its combat and movement, and listening to ArenaNet studio head Colin Johanson's answers during a subsequent Q&A, I'm happy to report that developer ArenaNet's history of pushing MMO boundaries seems to be alive and well. Guild Wars 3 looks to play unlike any other MMO on the market.

That's because instead of the action bar filled with abilities seen
title: Guild Wars 3 Plays Unlike Any Other MMO, And That’s A Good Thing

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Among horror royalty, there is perhaps no greater icon than Michael Myers. First appearing in 1978, the slasher helped ignite a trend of similar movie monsters that defined the next decade and beyond of the horror landscape.

Halloween: The Game displays a keen understanding of his special place in that lineage, and IllFonic has brought his unique sense of unrelenting menace to video games in a way I can't get enough of.

Halloween: The Game is a 4v1 asymmetrical horror game from a team that has established its brand on similar projects. From Friday the 13th and Predator: Hunting Grounds to Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed and Killer Klowns From Outer Space, IllFonic has spent the last decade becoming synonymous with this genre, and yet it's never made the same game twice. That's true again here, as one of Halloween's be
title: Halloween Cleverly Carves Its Own Path Through Horror Multiplayer

author: Kurt Indovina
description: Michael Myers comes alive in IllFonic's latest asymmetrical haunting grounds.
title: Halloween Cleverly Carves Its Own Path Through Horror Multiplayer – Review

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Guild Wars 3 developer ArenaNet wants to try "wild, crazy ideas" in a genre that, according to its studio head, has "stagnated" in recent years.

During a hands-off demo where early Guild Wars 3 gameplay was shown to members of the press, I asked ArenaNet studio head Colin Johanson about the state of the MMO genre in 2026 and what problems Guild Wars 3 is looking to solve.

title: MMOs Have “Stagnated,” Guild Wars 3 Studio Head Says

author: Callum Self
description:
If I put all of the games in my library together and found my favorite genre by hours played, the best roguelite games would come out on top. Dead Cells, The Rogue Prince of Persia, Noita, Reignbreaker, Returnal, and, of course, a little lesser-known game called Hades would all reign supreme as my Steam library’s most-played titles. One of those worthy of the list--perhaps one of the top three overall--would be Roboquest, an electrifying FPS that is currently cheaper than ever.

As a roguelite connoisseur and someone whose little brain signals get happy when I get a decent build during a run, Roboquest isn’t just a simple entry in the genre. At first glance, the stylized visuals with a cartoon-like aesthetic don’t seem too distinct--there are plenty of other titles using that same art st
title: Roboquest Is One Of The Highest-Rated Roguelites Of All Time, And It’s Cheaper Than Ever Right Now

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Sony's next State of Play broadcast is almost here, and with the next few months being packed with new game releases, we're expecting a beefy session of game trailers and announcements in today's broadcast. We already know that Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will be closing out the first half of the show, and it will be followed immediately by a new episode of State of Play Japan hosted by Yuki Kaji.

Beyond that, Sony has teased updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and third-party partners. If you're interested in watching, you can catch the livestream at 6 AM PT / 9 AM ET via this link or the embedded video below.
title: PlayStation State Of Play September 2026: All The Biggest Announcements, Games, And Trailers

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Frontier Developments, the UK-based game studio known for a great many creative management sims like Planet Coaster, Zoo Tycoon, and Jurassic World Evolution, has announced a deal with Disney--and it's gotten people excited about the possibilities.

In a news release, Frontier said the game is based on "Disney's iconic portfolio of IP" and will be "fully funded" by Frontier itself. Frontier will also publish it.

Frontier CEO Jo Cooke said in a statement, “We are delighted to announce this collaboration with Disney, which further reinforces our clearly defined strategy of developing and nurturing world-class creative management simulation game franchises."

title: Planet Coaster Dev Announces New Game With Disney, And That’s Very Exciting

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you looking for The Blood of Dawnwalker tips? This is an open-world RPG made by the talented folks who, once upon a time, helped with the development of The Witcher 3. You can expect everything from macabre creatures and dark fantasy themes, as well as unique mechanics that are totally refreshing for the genre. Of course, it goes without saying that things can get a tad bit confusing at first, which is why our guide aims to assist you for the long road ahead.

You’re a Dawnwalker - A part-human, part-vampire hybrid

title: 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Play The Blood Of Dawnwalker

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Most video games encourage you to keep trying. Even when all seems lost or when a challenge feels insurmountable, every failure is just part of the learning curve. But The Blood of Dawnwalker, from developer Rebel Wolves and publisher Bandai Namco, eschews that age-old mantra. Instead, it has a joke ending where you simply give up on the campaign and leave the game world forever.

In This Article
title: You Can Give Up In The Blood Of Dawnwalker And Leave Vale Sangora For Good

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you scratching your head about the Font of Life in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This magical relic holds untold power, enough to cure all ills and revitalize one’s body. But you have to decide who gets it: Coen, Anca, or no one. Our guide, which tackles the Where Old Devils Die and Stronger Than Achilles quests, has all the details for you.

description:
Are you planning to complete Echoes of Silenced Bells in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This side quest becomes available quite early in the campaign, though it’s up to you to decide when you ought to tackle it. We recommend doing this as soon as you’re able to, since it also leads to more quests and even a romance with your medic companion Anca.
